missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Знание' is a neuter noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Сила' is the nominative predicate noun joined by 'это'. A familiar proverb-style statement.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Знание' is the neuter accusative direct object of 'ценит', identical to the nominative. 'Глубокое' agrees in the neuter. A natural classroom sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Знания' is the neuter genitive after 'нет', and 'нужного' agrees in the genitive. A model for the genitive of -ие nouns.
Strategic focus: Dative governed by the verb. 'Знанию' is the dative required by 'учить' when naming the subject taught. 'Детей' is the animate accusative. A core teaching-verb pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental governed by the verb. 'Знанием' is the instrumental required by 'обладать'. 'Редким' agrees in the neuter instrumental. A clean instrumental-with-verb model.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Знании' is the prepositional form after 'о', the topic of discussion. 'Языков' is genitive plural marking what is known. A reliable prepositional model.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Знание' is the nominative subject of 'помогает'. 'Хорошее' agrees in the neuter, and 'в жизни' is prepositional. A natural value statement.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Знания' is the inanimate accusative plural of 'проверяет', matching the nominative plural. 'Наши' agrees in the plural. A natural exam sentence.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Знаний' is the genitive plural after 'много', the zero-ending form for -ие nouns. 'Полезных' agrees, and 'в книгах' is prepositional plural. A core quantity pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Знания' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' agrees, and 'важны' is the short-form plural predicate, intensified by 'очень'. A clean plural evaluation.
